note: Illustrative session. These are the hand-written reference queries from the scorecard, run on the synthetic ledger. This is not output from the live model.

turns.question: Which cost centre has the largest overdue amount?
turns.sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount_aed) AS overdue FROM invoices i JOIN cost_centres c ON c.cost_centre_id = i.cost_centre_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY c.cost_centre_id ORDER BY overdue DESC LIMIT 1
turns.explanation: Adds up the amounts of invoices marked overdue for each cost centre and keeps the largest.

turns.question: How many invoices are overdue?
turns.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue'
turns.explanation: Counts the invoices whose status is overdue.
